lede: The biggest thing on the calendar this week is Monday's Town Council meeting, where council takes up the Fourth Supplement to the Gondola IGA — extending cost-sharing on the 2027 planning budget for the gondola replacement — plus first readings of two ordinances, including one amending the Telluride Energy Mitigation Program. Over in Ouray County, commissioners are wrestling with a proposed EMS and Ridgway Fire merger and a fifth extension of their Emergency Disaster Declaration. Closer to home, the gondola is closed Monday for maintenance, and the week winds down with Halloween events including the Witches Ride and Young Frankenstein the Musical.

notable.stake: Council votes on gondola IGA extension and reads two new ordinances, including energy code changes.

Public update on federal funding pipeline the gondola project depends on; public comment open.
